description.value: Royal Bay Bakery has been baking on Vancouver Island since 1974, producing a wide range of artisan breads, pastries, savory pies, and café-style lunches using organic flour and locally sourced ingredients. The building runs on solar panels and the bakery offers a free EV charging station for customers, reflecting a genuine sustainability commitment that goes beyond marketing. A solid resupply stop for touring cyclists seeking fresh baked goods, made-to-order sandwiches, soups, and quality coffee in the Metchosin corridor west of Victoria.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and corroborates an active, well-established business (since 1974) at 3337 Metchosin Rd, Victoria, BC. The site explicitly mentions a free EV charging station and solar power, and the menu confirms hot savoury items and soups. No mention of bike-specific parking or water refill anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM record contains no address or phone number; both were sourced exclusively from the website and could not be cross-confirmed against OSM.
EV charging station mentioned on website is for motor vehicles; suitability for e-bike charging is unconfirmed and should not be assumed.
OSM category matched as 'Groceries' via shop=bakery, but this is primarily a bakery/café — the Grocery & Retail section is described only as 'See in store for seasonal goodies' with no specifics.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Established bakery and café on a cycling corridor west of Victoria with a broad food and beverage menu; a clear and practical resupply stop for touring cyclists.

provenance.category_correction_reason: OSM tag is shop=bakery; the business is primarily a full-service bakery and café with a small in-store grocery/retail section. 'Groceries' is a reasonable broad-category fit for the directory but the listing should be understood as a bakery/café stop.

Hot food.detail: Menu lists daily soup, hot savoury baked goods (Chicken Pie, Large Quiche, BBQ Beef Croissant, Steak and Mushroom, etc.), and made-to-order sandwiches

wow_evidence: baking on Vancouver Island since 1974... organic flour and locally sourced ingredients
